method: Existing Google Cloud Translation draft with agent corrections and independent AI review; no human/native-speaker validation
notes: Independently compared all 194 fields with the English source, including gameplay, community, download instructions, screenshots, navigation and accessibility controls.

Corrected musical playing, orders versus product orders, missing Korean particles around protected names, portable ZIP wording, match records versus schedules, sign-in and verified-release qualifications.
Reconciled 여관, 둥지 and 달리기 훈련장 with native game labels; corrected guide food supply, package distribution, military support and source-code labels.
Preserved early-access, guest/ranked sign-in, browser-save and signing-key qualifications, all placeholders, exact executable commands, filenames and literal screenshot counters.
AI linguistic review only. Natural language and rendered terminology may still benefit from native-speaker review; this record does not establish human validation or deployment.
Follow-up source-risk review restricts DejaVu derivation parenthetically to Glob2 Sans, not Nunito; skip links mean go to content.
